messages:
andre: Heads up — spike in GPU evictions in eu-west1 around 10:12 UTC. Lots of tiny pods anchoring slots, and gang workloads getting reordered -> preempted.
maya: Yep saw that. Eviction rate ~2.3x. Correlates with higher net-attach latencies and latebind timeouts.
li: Can you paste the event snippet? My hunch is NIC attach + anti-affinity leaves tiny residual slots ("silt") that block gang placement.
andre: Paste of events:
```
Events:
  Warning  Preempted   2m   kube-scheduler  Preempted by higher priority pod
  Normal   Scheduled   2m   kube-scheduler  Successfully assigned gpu-node-17
  Warning  AttachFailed  1m  kubelet        NetworkAttachment: timed out (link-local)
  Normal   Pulled      1m   kubelet        Successfully pulled image
```
samira: We already bumped preempt-window last week but warmpools are still sparse. A controlled defrag might help — cordon/evict tiny best-effort pods on a subset of nodes and let scheduler coalesce.
jon: Agree but doing full drains during peak is risky. Proposal: incremental compacting job that selects low-util racks, cordons a few nodes, drains only pods with label `job-type=tiny` and rebalances.
opsbot: defrag-runner queued for eu-west1c; will apply `canary=true` annotation and honor `no-evict=critical` label.
maya: Also consider a scheduler tweak: reduce lease timeout for tiny-pod queue to rescan sooner, and enable `preferCompact` for pods with `packing=compact` annotation.
li: Patch idea: lease heartbeat -> 20s for tiny-pod class and enable slot-sharing for best-effort to reduce fragmentation. Needs quick perf validation.
andre: Cost note — defrag will cause transient cross-rack pod moves, expect ~5% network egress bump during canary.
samira: Let's canary in eu-west1c with 5 nodes. If eviction delta falls and gang tail latency improves, roll to rest of eu-west1. @maya can you own the canary?
maya: :thumbsup: I'll kick it off and watch evictions + pod pending time + net-attach latency. opsbot, start canary-defrag.
deploy-bot: canary-defrag job started (id: cd-20240315-01) on eu-west1c — logs https://ci.internal/cd-20240315-01
jon: If canary fails, fallback plan: re-enable gated-scheduler-policy + increase warmpool padding and revert lease change.
andre: I'll collect metrics and post results in ~30m. Pulling eviction counts, `pod_pending_seconds`, and `net_attach_latency` now.
maya: Thanks — will have dashboard watchers on and a quick rollback playbook ready. :white_check_mark:
